checks.evidence: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is software that can do tasks that normally need human thinking, such as answering questions. A language model is a type of AI that writes text after learning patterns from many examples. Training means the model looked at many sentences and learned how words usually follow each other. Retrieval‑Augmented Generation, or RAG, is a way to get better answers from a language model. First we look for useful text in our own notes. Then we give that text together with a question to the language model, which uses the text to help write its answer [S1].
